title: NeuroTUMBCI2025
description: A mobile EEG motor imagery dataset recorded from two pilots, one tetraplegic and one able-bodied, during development of the neuroTUM brain-computer interface for the 2024 Cybathlon BCI race. Data were acquired with a 24-channel wireless Smarting mobi system at 250 Hz using a cue-based arrow paradigm. Each participant performed a subject-specific set of three mental tasks drawn from rest, hand motor imagery, and foot motor imagery.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 24-channel wireless Smarting mobi (mBrainTrain) amplifier at 250 Hz using a 10-20 montage. Each trial consisted of a 3 s fixation reset, a 1 s directional visual cue, a 3 s black-screen execution period for motor imagery, and a 3 s reset. Recordings were made offline without feedback and stored as XDF files across multiple sessions per participant.
